pr_title: Work around a sound issue when loading saves
pr_body:
Closes #17359.

Testcase is described in https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/issues/17359#issuecomment-687791308.

This is only a workaround since the original issue (the menu being closed without `onExit` running, leaving bogus state), but I don't know how to solve that directly. (Probably needs a larger widget rework?)

issue_context.title: Sound issue when loading savegames in-game
issue_context.body:
From the website comments:
"If in-game you load a saved game too many times(about 3 times), unit sound stops working, I gotta return to main menu and load from there to fix the issue."
comments:
http://www.openra.net/news/release-20191117/#comment-4694794568

He also noted that

> Another issue is while I'm playing, music suddenly stops working. I gotta restart it on the music menu.

I tried to reproduce the issue but without success so far.

I also can't reproduce this, so without any extra information to suggest otherwise I expect that this is our standard Windows-OpenAL heisenbug.

There's nothing to action on, so removing from the milestone.

I have the same issue on Ubuntu 18.04, which leads me to believe this is not related to the OS. I'm a former software dev and could provide some debugging info, if someone lets me know what is of interest.
@abcdefg30 have you found a repro case so we can try to fix this?

Yes, you need to open the menu on a timing when you lose a mission (just press esc once you hear "mission failed"). The manually opened menu will mute the world sounds, but the game over logic opens it again somehow and then plays the fmv. This causes `cachedDisableWorldSounds` being set to `true` and thus muting all sounds when leaving the menu after loading: https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/blob/bleed/OpenRA.Mods.Common/Widgets/Logic/Ingame/MenuButtonsChromeLogic.cs#L106

https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/blob/006a87692a2d4ae5d3e5ea3c55ea1a41d81b0378/OpenRA.Mods.Common/Widgets/Logic/Ingame/LoadIngamePlayerOrObserverUILogic.cs#L78 will likely be the problem here, I'll try to make that check if the menu is already open.
The much bigger issue here seems to be that `UI.CloseWindow` does not trigger `onExit`!

review_comments: IMO it would be wise to have a short comment here explaining that this is needed to work around possible bogus existing Game.Sound state.
Updated. Hope the wording is ok.
